run_udp_decode: decode keypoints from model predicted heatmaps using UDP distribution aware coordinate decoding
run_gaussian_blur: apply Gaussian blur modulation to model predicted heatmaps with a configurable kernel size
run_get_heatmap_maximum: get the maximum response location and value from 3D or 4D heatmaps
run_refine_keypoints_dark_udp: refine keypoint predictions using distribution aware coordinate decoding for UDP with heatmap gradients
run_nms: greedily select detection boxes with high confidence and IoU overlap below a threshold
